gates.diff: 10 of 11 changed-src files hash-equal to b18; p2_a1_board_top.v differs on exactly one line (CAM_SEL 1->0); SDC/ADC hash-equal
gates.merge: C01-C16 pass; C17 A-branch pairs=17 diffs=0; C18' real-top stub expects sysstat=0x00000F1D (bit12=0, bit20=0, lane_sticky=4'hF), A signature reaches u_a1, B signature does not
gates.sim: T1 A geometry source_groups=2,117,472 / line_rises=2,192 / frame_rises=1 / frame_falls=1 / crop_roi_frames=1 / crop_groups=518,400 / raw_len=2,592,000 / enc=1 / exported=1 / four CRC+zlib / no half frame; T2 16/16 readback wstrb=0; T3 P1 three goldens byte-identical; T4 drop-R retry exports, no deadlock; T5 273/6/67, field #13 bit12=0, bit20=0, lane_sticky=4'hF, diag_flags bits1..5=0, v5 accepted; vlog Errors:0
gates.synth: <=2 attempts, SWNS >= 0, TNS >= 0, 0 violations, ERAM + CWC <= 300
gates.route: <=1 attempt, 0 violated endpoints, hold >= 0, period positive; WNS >= +0.05 target; +0.003..<+0.05 only diagnostic with timing_caveat=thin_margin_+0.0xx; < +0.003 or any violation -> stop, no bitgen
gates.bit: 1 bitgen + 1 CWC; fail-closed SETUP/HOLD/PERIOD; bit/CWC/BID sha256; cw/compiled.bit|.cwc byte-identical; <phy_eram> present, no incomplete <logic_eram/>
gates.board: preflight FTDI 0403:6042 + COM8 with COM8 closed; 1 SRAM download b19 bit; reset_pulse recorded; COM8 300 s; CAM_SEL bit12=0, bit20=0; v6 273/6/67 bad_xor=0; A pix_beats>0, line_rises>0, frame_rises>0; enc>0; exported>0; >=1 FRAME four CRCs+zlib; no half frame; raw_drop/raw_abort not growing; timeout/retry/giveup not growing (absolute 0 if one packet, deltas 0 if >=2)
gates.board_no_pixels: if A pix/line/frame all 0: keep 300 s capture + status_v6 + cam_* + phystat + sysstat + lane_sticky; board=blocked_A_no_pixels; A front-end/hardware conclusion; no rebuild, no second download/capture
gates.board_giveup: if giveup grows: keep timeout_ar_addr/low3 + last_issued_ar_addr + diag_flags + inflight_state; stop; no second bitstream/capture/Flash

hardware.preflight: Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly match VID_0403&PID_6042 and HKLM SERIALCOMM COM8; absent -> board=blocked, 0 downloads, 0 COM8
hardware.order: FTDI preflight -> 1 SRAM download with COM8 closed -> verify B19_DL_OK -> close hwserver/JTAG -> reset alignment -> open COM8 300 s
hardware.reset_alignment: operator pulses board reset R14 (sys_rst_n) once after download to restart both camera cores and zero counters; log reset_pulse=yes/no + timestamps; wait ~2 s; if no pulse possible, capture anyway and mark missing frame ambiguous -> board=blocked
hardware.capture: 300 s at 115200 8N1 (worst-case stored frame 2,594,706 B = 225.2 s); outdir r0/board/captures_a
hardware.release: close COM8 before any further JTAG; no second download; no re-capture

path_contract.td: T: = T10.b19-cam-a/r0/td, Y: = D:\fpga\ph1p100; never map X: to the project root; run tools/td/td_env.ps1 first

stop_rule: conformance after 2 attempts; sim gate failure; 2 synth below target; route violated or < +0.003; bitgen/CWC failure; board giveup growing; A no pixels; budget exhausted -> stop and return to the original planner. No second download, no second capture, no Flash, no SDC/clock/seed change, no batch delete.

tester.role: new independent integrated tester (not the developer)
